content.title: Spectrum SportsNet Plus FAQ | Los Angeles Lakers
content.text: Frequently Asked QuestionsSpectrum SportsNet+ is a 24/7 digital stream of Spectrum SportsNet that is available to fans without a cable or satellite subscription living in the Lakers local broadcast territory. Spectrum SportsNet+ includes over 70 live Lakers games during the 2025-26 season as well as pregame and postgame coverage and Emmy Award-winning original Lakers programming. Spectrum Sportsnet+ is available exclusively on NBA.com and the NBA App.70+ local games are available for live and on-demand viewing on Spectrum SportsNet+. Lakers games exclusively broadcasted by ABC, NBC, Peacock and Prime Video will not be available on Spectrum SportsNet+.In addition to live games, Spectrum SportsNet+ includes comprehensive pregame and postgame coverage and award-winning original programming including "Backstage: Lakers".On-Demand viewing of completed Lakers games, original programming, and special coverage of historical events such as statue ceremonies and jersey retirements will also be available.Spectrum SportsNet+ is available to purchase on NBA.com. To purchase, click here.Please visit the Spectrum SportsNet+ packages page for the most up-to-date purchase options: www.nba.com/sportsnet.Yes, monthly subscriptions will automatically renew. Annual subscriptions will expire on September 30th, 2026.Spectrum SportsNet+ is available exclusively on NBA.com and the NBA App. The NBA App is available across a wide range of devices. Please visit this page for a full list of supported devices.Spectrum SportsNet+ is available to anyone who lives inside the Lakers local broadcast territory. That includes all of Southern California, Hawaii and parts of Southern Nevada.No. You must reside within the Lakers local broadcast territory. If you reside outside the territory, local Lakers games are available via an NBA League Pass package.Yes. Spectrum video customers who receive SportsNet as part of their service will be able to access Spectrum SportsNet+ via authentication. Current Spectrum SportsNet subscribers can also live stream games on the Spectrum SportsNet App.Yes. Spectrum SportsNet+ is available to subscribers when they travel domestically within a 30-day period.No. DVR is not available on Spectrum SportsNet+. However, game replays are available approximately 3 hours after a game has completed, as well as On Demand episodes for programs like "Backstage: Lakers."Spectrum SportsNet+ offers year-round coverage of the Lakers. Off-season coverage includes new episodes of "Access SportsNet: Lakers" every week as well as comprehensive coverage of the NBA Draft, Free Agency and Summer League. In addition, Spectrum SportsNet+ offers 15+ live L.A. Sparks games.Yes, Video on Demand offerings are available. Click here to visit the Spectrum SportsNet+ hub. If you are experiencing technical issues, please submit a request here.
